tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bka' bstan 'gyur gyi dkar chag rnam par dbye ba la log rtog kun sel zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

/bla ma dang gsung gi mnga' bdag 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras mchog spangs rtogs phun sum tshogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*// zhi ba 'dod chags bral ba 'gog lam bden pa mngon gyur dam chos rin chen dang*// rig grol gnyis ldan 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyi tshogs mchog la// skabs gsum klu dang gnod sbyin dri za mi 'am ci dang lto 'phye 'byung po bdag sogs skyabs su mchi// srid zhi'i rgud pa'i sdug bsngal ma lus mtha' dag rab zhi zhing*// bdud bzhi'i g.yul las kun rgyal rgyal ba'i bstan la gnas nas su// tshogs sbyor mthong spang sgom lam sa bcur rab bgrod nas// don gnyis mthar phyin phyir mi ldog dang rdo rje 'dzin pa thob mdzad gsol// de yang skye rgu sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i go 'phang mchog la 'god pa'i phan pa dang bde ba'i rtsa lag ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che gnas shing rgyas par bya dgos te/ bstan pa'i snying po rgyal ba'i dam chos dag la rag ces gsungs te/ de nyid gang zhe na/ lung rtogs dang bka' 'grel bzhi'o// dang po la gnyis/ ston pa'i dam chos rnam gnyis te// lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid de// de 'dzin byed pa smra byed pa// sgrub pa byed pa kho na'o// zhes rtogs pa'i chos nyams su blangs nas theg pa chen po'i mthong lam rjes su 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob par byed dgos/ gnyis pa la gnyis lung gi chos te/ bka'i dgongs pa de nyid bstan bcos kyi 'grel zhing bstan dgos te/ de skad du yang*/ lha yi bus zhus pa'i mdo las/ chos rnams thams cad bka' dang bstan bcos gnyis// legs par gsungs dang de yi dgongs 'grel dang*// de yi dbang gi shākya'i bstan pa ni// 'jig rten khams 'dir yun ring gnas par 'gyur// zhes pas bstan pa dang sems can gyi don rgya chen po 'byung ba'i phyir dang*/

dpal ldan bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bka' srol bla na med pa gso ba'i slad du/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab gangs ri'i khrod 'dir 'gyur ro cog bka' 'grel bzhengs par 'dod pas/ dkar chag dag gi rnam par dbye ba bstan par bya ste/ de yang ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bka' 'gyur ro cog dri ma med pa rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul nas spyan drangs/ lo paṇa byang chub sems dpa' sprul pa'i skyes mchog dam pa rnams kyis legs par bsgrigs/ bka' bsdu ba/ sngon gyi rigs gsum mgon pos mdzad pa dag phyi mor mdzad pa rnams dang*/ de'i dgongs pa 'grel par byed pa bstan bcos 'gyur ro cog rnams/ dpal snar thang zha lu tshal gyi gtsug lag khang rnams su bzhugs pa rnams la/ bu ston kha che dang*/ bod phyi ma rjes 'brangs dang bcas pas/ bka' 'grel 'di rnams las gsang sngags snga 'gyur rnams/ dpal bsam yas su/ mkhan po bo dhi sa twa dang*/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas/ paṇ+ḍi ta ka ma la shī la/ rgyal po khri srong lde btsan sogs rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bsam yas kyi rgya dpe dag la gtugs pas des na/ phur pa rtsa dum gyi rgyud ma gtogs ma dag ces/ bu'i chos 'byung dag nas dor bar byas/ phur pa'i rgyud dag pa ci zhe na/ ma phyi bal po nas rnyed pas so// zhes gtan tshigs su bzhag de rnams ma dag pa/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od/ lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po/ khri btsun zhi ba 'od/ 'gos khug pa lha btsas rnams kyis sngags log sun 'byin nas kyang gsungs/ zhes brjod do// gsang sngags phyi 'gyur gyi nang nas dngos su ma dag ces brjod pa la/ bde mchog nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud/ bla ma'i yon tan brjod pa'i rgyud/ rdo rje blo dkar gyi rgyud/ lce spyang rol pa'i rgyud rnams ma dag gtan tshigs ni/ sngags kyi hūm̐ sogs la ring cha dang thung cha nor ba dag dang*/ mang nyung bla ma'i yon tan brjod pa nyung bar snang ba sogs bkod cing*/

gzhan yang rgyud rnams su ma dag pa dang*/ 'phros rtsal nas gso dgos pa dpyad par bya ba mtha' dag bshad pa dbu nas zhabs kyi bar du mang du bshad cing*/ bye brag tu'ang deng sang gsang sngags sgom pa'i dus min sogs mi 'thad la/ bstan 'gyur gyi'ang po ti phreng ba legs par bsgrigs te bzhugs pa'i go rim dag la/ mkhas pa bu dang*/ bod phyi ma rjes 'brangs rnams/ da lta bstan 'gyur bzhugs pa'i go rim snga rabs pa dag gis mdzad pa mi 'thad de/ thog mar mchog dman bar ma'i go rim dag las/ mchog gi bstod pa mngon du btang bas so// 'o na go rim ji lta bu zhe na/ bstan pa la 'jug cing lam rgyud la skye ba'i go rim dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i go rim nas bzhugs dgos/ zhes dang*/ chos 'khor dag la nges don bar par bkral nas bzhag dgos/ zhes sogs brjod pa'o// da lta bka' 'grel bzhugs pa rnams/ snga rabs pa rnams kyis rab tu ma phyes pa dag ste/ snga rabs pa rnams kyis bsgrigs shing bzhugs par byas pa 'di rnams la dag pa'i cha shas yod srid de/ yod nas dor na chos spong gi las su 'gyur bas bzhugs par bya ste/ de skad du 'ang*/ mi rigs pa yi chos la mi rigs na// the tshom za ba'i chos la smos ci dgos// rnam par g.yeng ba dag ni spangs nas su// de bas btang snyoms bzhag la nyes pa med// ces de dag gi blang dor byas te/ dag pa'i phyi mo zha lur bzhugs// zhes pa rnams phyogs snga mar byas pa dag go// da ni rang lugs nye bar bzhag par bya ste/ rgyal ba gnyis pa 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i dgongs pa dag las/ snga rabs pa 'di dag rnams khungs nyid du bya bar bzhed pa ltar bsgrub par bya ste/ bka' dang bstan bcos 'gyur ro cog gis bod yul du bstan pa dang sems can la/ phan bde 'byung ba la bka' drin che ba/ mi brjed pa'i gzungs brnyes pa'i bka'i bsdu ba po rnams kyis gsung rab gi tshig don gsal bar mdzad cing*/

rgyan drug mchog gnyis bka' drin che zhing*/ lha tho tho ri snyan shal gyi ring la dam pa chos kyi dbu brnyes/ ā tsar+ya bo dhi sa twa dang*/ rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma saṃ bha wa/ paṇ+ḍi ta ka ma la shī la rnams dang*/ chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum/ bla chen mkhan brgyud/ paṇa chen mkhan brgyud/ jo bo rje di' paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na sogs bka' drin che zhing*/ snyigs ma'i dus 'dir/ dam pa rigs brgya dang*/ rigs kun gyi bdag po gar dbang rdo rje 'chang chen po/ srid dang zhi ba'i dpal 'bar kun gyi skyabs gnas gnyen gcig pur gyur pa/ mgon po dri ma med pa'i thugs rje'i chu'i bsil zer 'phro bas tshim par mdzad pa/ dpal ldan khyab bdag gsang gsum gnas la mkhyen gnyis pha mthar son pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun thugs rje'i bdag nyid de nyid dang*/ de nyid kyi sku gsung thugs kyi bha ga lar byin gyis brlabs shing*/ dbang bzhi'i don la 'byor ba grub chen brgyad cu'i nang nas mngon par mtho ba/ rje btsun til+li pa chen po/ de nyid kyis rjes su bzung zhing*/ lnga rig pa'i paṇa grub nā len+d+ra'i byang sgo srung ba 'khor lo sdom pas byin gyis brlabs shing lung bstan thob nas/ bla ma'i phyogs su dka' chen dpag tu med pa spyad pa'i bdag nyid/ nā ro pa chen po dang*/ bod yul dbus kyi ma rig pa'i ling thog bsal zhing*/ bka' bab kyi chu bo chen po bzhi dbab cing*/ bshad sgrub kyi sgo nas bstan pa gsal bar mdzad pa/ rje btsun lho brag mar pa lo tsā ba chen po dang*/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi rtsa kha bye zhing rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel mngon du gyur nas mkhyen pa'i ye shes la dbang 'byor ba/ rje btsun chen po nyid dang*/ brgyud pa chu bo gsum 'dres mnga' zhing*/ lta sgom spyod gsum gcig tu mdzad nas/ ngur smrig gi rlabs phreng g.yo bas sa bcu la dbang bsgyur zhing*/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi lung bstan thob pa dpal sgam po ba chen po/

de nyid kyis rjes su bzung zhing srid zhi'i phun tshogs mnga' bas kun gyi rgud pa bsal zhing*/ gdul bya rnams smin grol gyi lam la 'god par mdzad pa mtha' rtsa ba chen po/ dgra bcom pa siṅga gling pas/ 'phags mchog klu sgrub sprul par lung bstan cing*/ ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas bdun par grags pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī bha dras/ thub pa'i rgyal tshab dam par mnga' gsol zhing*/ rgya bod kyi dbang phyug rnams dang lnga brgya ba yongs kyi gtsug gi nor bu/ snyigs ma'i dus su gdul bya'i don la gzigs te/ rnam 'phrul sna tshogs bkod pas mdzes pa'i rgyan du bltams te/ lhun grub 'bras bu'i dpal la dbang 'byor bas/ mdzad pa rlabs po che yongs su rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po/ chos kyi rje dpal ldan 'bri gung pa chen po zhes/ snyan pa'i ba dan dkar po sa gsum na g.yo ba de nyid dang*/ rje de'i gdung dang rigs las byung zhing*/ kun dga' bo dang chos mtshungs par gyur pa/ rgyal ba 'jig rten mgon po'i chos kyi gru bo che 'dzin cing*/ mkhas shing grub pa spyan snga 'bri gung gling pa/ chos rje'i dbon du gyur cing mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer rab tu 'phro ba sangs rgyas dbon dang*/ phrin las phul du phyin pa'i sprul sku gcung dang*/ mthu stobs thogs pa med pa thog kha ba dang*/ sgrub pa mtha' ru phyin pa'i mtshams bcad pa dang*/ thugs rjes kun la khyab pa'i bcu gnyis pa dang*/ dpal ldan pad+ma'i rnam 'phrul rdo rje rgyal po dang*/ rdo rje 'chang dngos dharma rā dza rje dang*/ bir+wa pa'i rnam 'phrul bco lnga pa dang*/ gtsug lag gnyis la dbang 'byor rin chen dpal gyi rgyal mtshan dang*/ sha ba ri pa'i sprul pa chos rgyal rin chen dpal bzang po/ gsang bdag gnyis pa rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ bstan pa'i rtsa lag 'dzin cing sgrub brgyud gsal bar mdzad pas/ kun las bka' drin che ba rin chen chos kyi rgyal po/

de nyid kyi thugs sras dam pa/ skyob pa nyid kyi nying sprul du shar ba/ 'gro ba du ma'i rnam 'dren/ rgyal ba mnyam med kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i ming 'dzin zhing*/ 'bri gung 'og min chos kyi pho brang gi seng ge'i khri la gnas pa'i bar/ brgyud pa yid bzhin nor bu rin po che'i phreng ba spel legs pa lta bur byon pa rnams kyis/ bshad sgrub nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor gsal zhing 'od 'phro/ rnam dag dbang gi chu bo gaṅgā byin rlabs kyi rgyun ma chad/ sgrub brgyud gser ri'i rtse mo bsam gtan gyi bka' ma zhig rim gnyis lhun po'i dbang po ltar brtan zhing*/ phrin las chu bo'i rgyun ltar gzhan las ches khyad par du 'phags pa'i bstan pa phyogs thams cad dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ ces yongs su grags shing mngon du gyur pas na bka' drin che la/ de ltar lo paṇa rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa' khyad par can rnams kyis/ bod 'dir rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad cing*/ bka' dang bstan bcos 'gyur ro cog rnams kyang*/ gcig tu legs par bsgrigs nas dkar chag mdzad pa/ dbus gtsang gnyis su mang du bzhugs kyang*/ phyis bstan pa mar 'grib kyi babs nas 'thor bar gyur pa la/ mkhas par grags pa'i bu ston dang*/ bod phyi ma rnams kyis dpyad pas gtan la phab ste/ ma dag rnams dor/ dag pa rnams bsgrigs zhes bsngags pa brjod cing phyi mor byed pa dag dang*/ dkar chag snga mar yod pa'i gsung rab dor ba rnams te/ de rnams kyi bshad srol dag las/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma'i rjes 'brangs rnams kyis mdzad pa'i gsang sngags snga 'gyur las/ phur pa rtsa dum gyi rgyud ma gtogs ma dag ces dang*/ deng sang gsang sngags phyi 'gyur gsar ma rnams kyang nyams su len pa'i dus min zhes dang*/ rgyud kyi po ti ko btums rgyab nas gter du sbas zhes gleng ba rnams/ byis pa'i ngang tshul can shes rab 'chal ba'i rang bzhin can mkhas zhes par grags lo tsam la gnas shing*/

tshig la byang yang don la brtul bar mngon no// de ci zhe na/ shes byed yod de/ rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dag ni/ bdag cag gi ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dag las/ khyad par rnam pa gsum gyis 'phags// zhes so// de la gsum ste/ sku skye ba'i khyad par 'phags pa dang*/ sku tshe'i khyad par du 'phags pa dang*/ gdul bya'i khyad par 'phags pa'o// dang po/ sku skye ba'i khyad par du 'phags pa ni/ bdag cag gi ston pa mngal la brten te 'khrungs/ slob dpon chen po rdzus te 'khrungs pas so// gnyis pa sku tshe'i khyad par 'phags pa ni/ bdag cag gi ston pa le lo can brtson 'grus la 'god pa dang*/ rtag par lta ba sun 'byin pa'i phyir du mya ngan 'das pa'i tshul bstan la/ slob dpon chen po sku tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes pa'o// gsum pa gdul bya'i khyad par du byas pa/ bdag cag gi ston pa lha dang mi dang lha ma yin dang dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rang te/ slob dpon chen po snang srid kyi lha ma srid sde brgyad dang*/ 'khor 'das kyi 'byung po/ ston pa'i gdul byar ma gyur pa rnams btul zhing 'das ma 'ongs da ltar dus gsum mkhyen to// de yang 'das pa'i dus/ ye thog dang po'i mgon po 'khrul ma myong gi sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po yab yum du gyur nas khyad par gsum gyi khyad par gong du bstan pa ltar la brten nas/ gdul bya rnams smin par mdzad/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus su lung bstan pa rnams mthong chos bde blag tu rig pa'i rnam pa 'di lta bu rnams so// da ltar ba'i dus lho nub srin po'i kha gnon mdzad de/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa yun ring du gnas par mdzad pas so// de bas na gsang sngags rnying ma rnams kyang the tshom kyi chos su mi 'gyur/ gzhan yang gsang sngags gsar ma las nam mkha' mnyam rgyud kyang ma dag ce na/ de yang mi 'thad de/ dpal chen po rga lo rgya bod gnyis char du grags shing mkhas grub tshad ldan du byed pa dag gis 'di nyid gzhung du bkod de/

bde mchog lha lnga sogs mdzad pas so// rdo rje blos kar dang lce spyang rol pa'i sngags ring cha thung cha yod pa dang*/ bla ma'i yon tan brjod pa la chos tshan mang nyung snang bas ma dag pa sogs dpyad pa thal bar 'gyur te/ dper na dag pa'i rgyud rnams su'ang sngags kyi ring thung chos tshan mang nyung yod pas so// gsang sngags gsar ma nyams su len pa'i dus min zhes pa'ang mi 'thad de/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis ma 'ongs pa snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i dus su nyon mongs pa rags shing mthong chos bde blag tu ston pa'i skabs su nyams su len par dgongs nas/ gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa gsungs shing*/ bai ro tsa na'i 'dra 'bag las ston pa'i zhal nas/ nga ni 'di na mi snang nas// lo ni brgya dang bcu gnyis na// lha gnas gsum du grags pa yi// bstan pa'i snying po dam pa zhig /'dzam gling shar gyi phyogs mtshams kyi// mi las skal ldan rigs can te// rgyal po dzaḥzhes bya ba la// sngon du ltas rnams snang bar 'gyur// drag shul can zhes bya ba'i ri// grogs kyi sems can smin pa'i rigs// laṅka'i bdag po la sogs pa// lag na rdo rjes snang bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang*/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dang gnyis su med pa/ jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha dang*/ bcom ldan rig pa'i ral gri/ thar pa lo tsā ba/ dpal ldan dwags po bka' brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyis gsungs pa'i dgongs pa rnams don med par 'gyur ro// ston pa nyid kyi zhal nas/ bya rgod phung po'i ri bo ru// shes rab pha rol phyin tshul bstan// de bzhin dpal ldan 'bras spungs su// tshul bstan sngags kyi rgyud rab bshad// ces dang*/ ston pa sangs rgyas nas lo phyi mar/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i dam pa dang po'i rgyud dang 'grel pa gsungs pas so// deng sang gsang sngags dus min zhes smra ba jo bo'i lugs dang 'gal/ jo bo gsang sngags spyod bzhin du/

gsang sngags spyod la nan tan mdzad// ces 'dir smra ba'o// rje btsun mi la'i zhal nas kyang*/ bod ngan pa'i snying la 'dre zhugs te/ a ti sha gsang sngags 'chad du ma bcug pas mi mang po phung du bcug gsungs skad/ rje 'jig rten mgon po'i zhal nas kyang*/ nyams su len pa yod na 'bras bu 'thob pa rgyun mi 'chad de/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' so so'i skye bo dag kyang*/ rdo rje theg pa gsang sngags la ma brten par sangs rgya mi srid de/ nyon mongs pa phra rags gnyis su byas te/ rags pa mtshan nyid kyi theg pas spong la/ phra ba rdo rje theg pa sngags kyis spang dgos pa'i phyir dang*/ phra rags ma spangs pa'i sangs rgyas 'byung mi srid/ ces gsungs shing*/ rnam snang mngon par byang chub pa las/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas gang bzhugs dang*// de bzhin gang yang ma byon dang*// da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams// 'gro la phan phyir gsang sngags kyi// cho ga zab mo 'di mkhyen nas// dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du// bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa// dpung chen yang ni der bcom ste// de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir// bu yi blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces pa rnams kyi dag par ma mngon te/ dkar chag dag gi phyi mo dang khungs nyid du ma byas so// sngon gyi lo paṇa skyes mchog dam pa rnams dang*/ khyad par mkhas shing grub pa thob la/ phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa dag gis blang dor spangs shing*/ thugs kyi mkhyen pa gzu bor gnas pa/ bcom ldan rig pa'i ral gri dang*/ thar pa lo tsā ba chen po dag gis skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la legs par phab nas/ bka' dang bstan bcos 'gyur ro cog gi dkar chag mdzad de/ dpal snar thang du bzhugs pa dag la phyi mo bgyis te/ 'phri bsnan med par legs par bzhengs pa'o// gzhan yang phyogs snga mar bkod pa'i lha bla ma ye shes 'od dang*/ lo tsā rin chen bzang po/ khri btsun zhi ba 'od/

'gos khug pa lha btsas rnams kyis 'di rnams ma dag ces pa'i gtan tshigs bzhag snang ba dang*/ khong rang rnams kyi rtsam chos dag tu/ snga rabs pa rnams la rjes dpag gi dpyad pa med cing*/ yang dag pa'i khungs nyid du bgyid do// bstan 'gyur gyi go rim dang chos 'khor gyi rnam dag kyang mi 'thad de/ gong du bstan pa las/ legs par sbyangs pa'i mkhas pa dag gi dgongs pa cung mi 'dra ba'i khyad par byung ba ni bstan pa la 'jug cing lam rgyud la skye ba'i go rim dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i go rim nas bzhugs dgos gsungs mod/ des na dang po go rim de ltar dgos na/ rig pa'i gnas lnga las/ tshar gcod pa'i rig pa sgra dang tshad ma/ rjes su 'dzin pa'i rig pa bzo dang gso ba rnams dbu dang*/ rang nyid kun shes shing smin par bya ba'i rig pa mjug tu 'gyur la/ de bzhin du gsung rab ston pa la/ theg pa chung ngu'i bstan bcos dbu dang*/ theg chen sems bskyed dang 'brel ba'i bstan bcos zhabs su dgos par 'gyur/ lam rgyud la skye ba'i rim pa ltar bzhugs dgos na/ so skye lam zhugs dbu dang nyan rang byang sems bar dang*/ sangs rgyas mjug tu bzhugs dgos par thal ba'i nyes pa 'di gnas pas mi 'thad la/ 'dir zab cing rgya che ba'i rgyud 'grel rnams nas/ mchog dang 'bring dang dman pa'i bar rim pa ltar bzhugs pa ni dam pa'i lugs dang mthun zhing*/ go rim mi 'khrugs pas shin tu legs la/ dkon mchog rin chen rnam pa gsum gyi bstod pa ni/ dam pa'i chos rin po che 'byung ba'i gnas dang gtso bo yin pas/ thog mar/ sangs rgyas chos dang 'phags pa'i tshogs// zhes smos dgos te de skad du'ang*/ srid pa gsum na rgyal ba dkon mchog gtso// de yi 'og tu de las byung ba'i chos// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun skyes chen brgyad po ni// srid gsum bsod nams 'phel ba'i rgyu yin phyir// dngos grub 'dod pas gsang sngags mgo ru 'don// zhes pas de ltar 'god dgos la/

zab lam rgyud 'grel rnams nas kyang*/ mchog dman bar ma'i khyad par ltar bzhugs/ zhes pas/ go rim ma 'khrugs pas shin tu legs la/ rjes su bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa rnams dang*/ bsngo ba smon lam gyi bar legs par bzhugs par mdzad pa bstan 'gyur snga rabs pa'i go rim las/ thog mar ka pa la/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bstod pa slob dpon ma ti tsi tras mdzad pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta bid+ya ka ra sing ha pra bha dang*/ lo tsā ba dpal rtsegs kyi 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pa bzhugs pas so// chos 'khor tha ma nges don te/ skyob pa 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i zhal nas/ mdo dang don gyi gnad kyis 'khor lo gsum du 'dus gsungs/ mdo don dam pa yang dag 'phags kyi dgongs pa nges par 'grel pa'i mdo'i lung las/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bden pa bzhi las brtsams te/ chos kyi 'khor lo dang po bskor ba de ni bla na mchis pa/ skabs mchis pa/ drang ba'i don/ rtsod pa'i gzhi'i gnas su gyur pa'o// bcom ldan 'das kyi chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang*/ mtshan ma med pa dang*/ smon pa med pa dag las brtsams te/ chos kyi 'khor lo bar pa bskor ba de ni/ bla na mchis pa/ skabs mchis pa/ drang ba'i don/ rtsod pa'i gzhi'i gnas su gyur pa lags so// bcom ldan 'das kyis/ tha ma nges don rnam par phye ba'i tshul gyi/ chos kyi 'khor lo gsum pa bskor ba de ni/ bla na ma mchis pa/ skabs ma mchis pa/ nges pa'i don/ rtsod gzhi'i gnas su ma gyur ba lags so// zhes gsungs pas phyi ma nges pa'i don du bzhag la/ gang zag gi rgyud la skye ba'i rim pa dang sbyar bas/ don gyi gnad rim gyis par bshad pas kyang nges don tha ma'o// nges don bar pa yin na/ bka' tha ma chos 'khor gsum du ma gtogs pa'i skyon yod/ ces gsungs so// des na rnam par dbye ba shes par bya ba rang lugs so// de ltar dag par bgyid pa dag gi lugs rnams legs par bdag gis bzhengs pa'i tshul las thog mar/

bka' 'gyur sngon po gser dngul gyis brgyan par byas pa po ti brgya dang*/ sngags 'bum po ti gcig dang brgya rtsa gcig rnams legs par grub cing*/ glegs shing sku rags na bza'i bye brag tshang ba/ bstan 'gyur nyid kyang sngon po gser dngul gyis brgyan par byas te/ po ti gril pod chen mo brgya dang bdun/ lañtsa po ti gcig dang brgya dang brgyad do// de dag gi'ang glegs shing sku rags na bza'i bye brag rnams legs par grub pa'o// rgyas par dkar chag chen mor blta bar bya'o// swa sti/ dpag yas bskal par tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs shing*// sgrib gnyis nyes pa'i dri mas ma gos pa'i// don gnyis dbyer med chos rje yab sras kyi// sku gnyis mthar phyin sangs rgyas thob bya'i phyir// bden gnyis zung 'jug bka' dang bstan bcos gnyis// tshogs gnyis rdzogs phyir bzhengs pa'i dge ba des// rtog gnyis gnyis 'dzin sgrib pa rab sbyangs nas// gnyis med rdo rje ye shes thob par shog /

ces pa 'di nyid shākya'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ dad ldan 'byor pas khengs shing gtong ba'i blo gros can dag rgyal ba'i bka' 'grel dri ma med pa bzhengs pa'i dge bas/ sangs rgyas go 'phang myur du nges par thob pa'i lhag pa'i bsam pa yongs su rdzogs shing*/ phyi mo dag la the tshom dang yid gnyis gnyis 'dzin gyi 'ching ba gcod cing*/ dad pa dang dang ba dang yid ches bskyed pa'i slad du/ cam bu ma yin par snying nas gzhan gces 'byongs pa'i blo dang*/ rang nyid bsags pa bgrang zhing brjed thor byas te/ chu mo lug gi lo la gdan sa chen po 'bri gung 'og min chos kyi pho brang du sbyar ba'i rnam dkar dge bas bstan pa dang sems can la phan thogs par gyur cig/// mad+galaṃ/// /
